description: Local-first personal finance tool based on zero-sum budgeting, supporting synchronization across devices, custom rules, manual transaction importing (from QIF, OFX, and QFX files), and optional automatic synchronization with many banks.

promotion.reason: The pinned image was last rebuilt on 2023-08-07, while the project has released many times since. Three years of unpatched base-image changes. Revisit when the definition pins a current release.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Your budget and account history live only in this app's folder on this computer. Nothing is sent anywhere, and nothing is backed up for you.
